subject: Uncertain Terms
author: ZombieTron
body:
The Save Burnout Revenge group on Facebook (now disbanded) emailed Alex when ther servers came back online and they got this response:

Hello,

God moves in mysterious ways!

Enjoy the game….again!

Peace and love,

alex.

Everyone seems to be taking this as confirmation the game is back, but I think it's pretty vague and doesn't confirm the servers are back on because someone consciously made that decision, or if it's incidental to other work done on the servers or some other happy accident that EA will rectify when they realise the error.

I know we are all jumping up and down with excitement and happiness about being able to play online again, and I hope it lasts a very long time... but I am hesitant to celebrate too much just to be disappointed again if it is only temporary.

subject: Woop!

body:
Couldn`t believe it, but got online and had some great races. Hopefully, they will stay on as it does seem to be a breach of terms of the game. Especially as you can still buy it. Unsuspecting people who found out they could not play online are right to feel cheated, as we all do, so hopefully a retraction is due to false advertisment. 

 

The burners have spoken.
